current: qip_edge::journal::Journal is an unbounded Vec<JournalEntry> that is never trimmed (entries are kept after shipping), hash-chained on the decision path, and drained by Cell::flush -> journal::ship -> Mirror::ship. In the only composition root that runs passes (qip-edge-node serve loop), cell.flush(mirror) is called synchronously on the same thread, immediately before run_pass, and StoreMirror::ship performs a synchronous KeyValueStore write. There is no preallocated bounded ring, no separate core and no asynchronous drain thread; the journal module doc's 'never happens on the hot path' holds for Cell::work itself but not for the loop that drives it.
